newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Shinawatra Satel rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Shinawatra Satel rated buy.

text.p: Asia Equity said on Tuesday it had ugraded its recommendation on shares in Thailand's Shinawatra Satellite Plc to a trading buy from a sell.
A report by the company cited strong earnings growth and low prices as major reasons for the new recommendation.

"Strong earnings growth of 17 percent this year and 61 percent next year -- underpinned by doubling of transponder capacity and increase of lease rental since most new contracts will be charged with higher tariffs," it said.

Asia Equity had downgraded the company's 1997 earnings forecasts by 11 percent to 281 million baht ($10.80 million) from 316 million because of increased losses of its 70-percent owned subsidiary -- Satellite Service Company (SSV).

"We forecast SSV to make a loss of 132 million baht this year but to break even next year. SSV will spend two billion baht to build downlink stations and acquire dishes for DTH services," the report said.
"In addition, the investment will dry up SSV's funds which had been providing interest income," it added.
Despite this, Asia Equity expected the company's satellite operation to improve with an increase in lease rental from its Thaicom 3 satellite which is due to be launched on April 12.
